notes.title: Demo Update #1: Compendium, Card Buffs, Bugfixes & more
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing the pre-alpha prototype!

We’ve reviewed your feedback and are actively working on improvements.

As some of you mentioned in your feedback that you'd like to look up keywords, we've created the Compendium.

In the Compendium, you can track all the cards you've already played. We also keep track of whether you've completed runs using these cards. In the future, cards from completed runs will be marked accordingly.

Feel free to complete your Compendium. And if you do, we’d love to see a screenshot! 😊

New Features
Added Basic Compendium: view all Cards, Soul Shards, and Keywords you've seen and used during your playthrough

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562608/6545e33fbca9dc225d4f153f2d275e0ad30d3d6e.png"]
General Improvements
Language is now automatically selected on the first game launch

Various text improvements and typo fixes

Cards now show Tooltips for

effects on cards they reference

effects that are referenced by another effect (like increase)

New Tutorial Step: Teaches how to use your heal flask without consuming Energy while on the map.

General tooltips are now larger for improved readability.
Bug Fixes
Fixed: Corrosive Venom now correctly goes to the void instead of the discard pile

Fixed: Insecure + Outbreak no longer results in an unintended instant win combo

Fixed: Broken tooltip at Smithy

Fixed: Wrong base value on some cards with modifiers

Fixed: Blizzard echo calculation

Fixed: Preview for cards with echo (previously only worked for damage)

Fixed: Some cards showing broken or irrelevant tooltips
Balance Changes
Gameplay & Decks

Improved Pride starter deck

Celestial Dart: Reverted to 4 damage when the condition is met

Improved merchant card selection
